name: live-line-chart
title: LiveLineChart
description: Point time is Unix seconds. Latest value is a separate required prop. Defaults: 30-second window, 5 ticks, leading offset 0, lerpSpeed 0.08 and height 300px. paused freezes scrolling while latest-value interpolation and Y-range changes continue. Invalid window/ticks/speed revert to defaults. The demo source updates every second, supports stopping and cleans up on unmount; the component does not open a WebSocket.
